## Release — backlog-campaign v0.25.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.25.0

#### Stacked PRs

- Campaign dispatch now checks for a stack parent before creating a worktree, so an issue that overlaps an open PR targets that PR's branch instead of `main`. Previously the dispatch checklist always branched from `main`.
- Overlap detection now reads the real changed files of each open PR instead of relying on declared paths. If a PR's files can't be read, detection falls back to declared paths. This read works on GitHub only; Gitea and GitLab keep using declared paths.
- Broad paths with a literal prefix, such as `src/**`, now trigger stacking when they match a PR's real files. `**`, `*.md` and `default_touch_paths` still never trigger it on their own.
